pairs: Factum est autem Iconii, ut simul introirent in synagogam Judæorum,
Now it happened in Iconium that they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews,
et loquerentur, ita ut crederet Judæorum et Græcorum copiosa multitudo.
and they spoke in such a way that a copious multitude of both Jews and Greeks believed.
suscitaverunt et ad iracundiam concitaverunt animas gentium adversus fratres.
the Jews who were unbelieving had incited and enflamed the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
they remained for a long time,
offering testimony to the Word of his grace,
et prodigia fieri per manus eorum.
providing signs and wonders done by their hands.
Then the multitude of the city was divided.
et quidam quidem erant cum Judæis,
And certainly, some were with the Jews,
yet truly others were with the Apostles.
Cum autem factus esset impetus gentilium et Judæorum cum principibus suis,
Now when an assault had been planned by the Gentiles and the Jews with their leaders,
ut contumeliis afficerent, et lapidarent eos,
so that they might treat them with contempt and stone them,
intelligentes confugerunt ad civitates Lycaoniæ Lystram et Derben,
they, realizing this, fled together to Lystra and Derbe,
cities of Lycaonia, and to the entire surrounding region.
And they were evangelizing in that place.
Et quidam vir Lystris infirmus pedibus sedebat,
And a certain man was sitting at Lystra, disabled in his feet,
This man heard Paul speaking. And Paul,
et videns quia fidem haberet ut salvus fieret,
and perceiving that he had faith, so that he might be healed,
Turbæ autem cum vidissent quod fecerat Paulus,
But when the crowds had seen what Paul had done,
they lifted up their voice in the Lycaonian language, saying,
Dii similes facti hominibus descenderunt ad nos.
“The gods, having taken the likenesses of men, have descended to us!”
‘Mercury,’ because he was the lead speaker.
tauros et coronas ante januas afferens,
in front of the gate, bringing in oxen and garlands,
was willing to offer sacrifice with the people.
And as soon as the Apostles,
conscissis tunicis suis exilierunt in turbas,
had heard this, tearing their tunics, they leapt into the crowd,
annuntiantes vobis ab his vanis converti ad Deum vivum,
preaching to you to be converted, from these vain things,
et terram, et mare, et omnia quæ in eis sunt:
who made heaven and earth and the sea and all that is in them.
qui in præteritis generationibus dimisit omnes gentes ingredi vias suas.
In previous generations, he permitted all nations to walk in their own ways.
Et quidem non sine testimonio semetipsum reliquit benefaciens de cælo,
he did not leave himself without testimony,
filling their hearts with food and gladness.”
vix sedaverunt turbas ne sibi immolarent.
they were barely able to restrain the crowds from immolating to them.
Supervenerunt autem quidam ab Antiochia et Iconio Judæi: et persuasis turbis,
Now certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium arrived there. And having persuaded the crowd,
they stoned Paul and dragged him outside of the city,
But as the disciples were standing around him,
he got up and entered the city.
et postera die profectus est cum Barnaba in Derben.
And the next day, he set out with Barnabas for Derbe.
And when they had evangelized that city,
strengthening the souls of the disciples,
and exhorting them that they should remain always in the faith,
et quoniam per multas tribulationes oportet nos intrare in regnum Dei.
and that it is necessary for us to enter into the kingdom of God through many tribulations.
Et cum constituissent illis per singulas ecclesias presbyteros,
And when they had established priests for them in each church,
they commended them to the Lord,
And traveling by way of Pisidia,
et loquentes verbum Domini in Perge,
And having spoken the word of the Lord in Perga,
And from there, they sailed to Antioch,
unde erant traditi gratiæ Dei in opus quod compleverunt.
where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work which they had now accomplished.
and had gathered together the church,
retulerunt quanta fecisset Deus cum illis,
they related what great things God had done with them,
et quia aperuisset gentibus ostium fidei.
and how he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
Morati sunt autem tempus non modicum cum discipulis.
And they remained for no small amount of time with the disciples.
